purpose: Discriminate the 58: 08 -> 77 transition seen in the first commit run

observations.test: further mailbox writes with other tags/values, each committed
observations.conclusion: the read side does not echo what the host writes, and a commit alone moves nothing

observations.test: the queue experiment repeated with a different seed
observations.conclusion: the value 77 does not follow the seed, so the first run's change was not the seeded word arriving

observations.test: read-only idle watch, no writes at all
observations.conclusion: the register does not drift on its own, so the one transition was not spontaneous

standing: 58 read 06 in the earlier ATGLK2B sweep, 08 at the start of queue-01, and 77 from the first commit onward. Something changed once and has not changed since. The mechanism is not established and the queue seeding is not demonstrated.
